textFlow: The note 
${path}
 of flow
 ${flowName}
 contains at least one UUID. 
This can happen because of sync errors.
How to proceed safely: 
1. Export ${flowName} to prevent any loss of edits.
2. Check the mentioned note for any additional regions that have been copied into it (search for '<hr>'), and cut them out.
3. Check the source notes of these regions to make sure they are up to date. If they aren't, copy/paste the latest version from your exported flow.
To make all of this easier, turn off navigation via file explorer (in the settings tab or command palette).
Afterwards try another rebuild.
----------- The Blurb: This is added as README to the system folder ---------------------------
readme:
This folder is textFlow's system folder. 
 
 **What it should contain:**
 - this README 
 - your flows
 - a .json file with your backups (not visible in Obsidian)
 
 **You may:** 
 - delete flow files from this folder
 - move this entire folder to a different location
 
 **But please do not:** 
 - add files to this folder
 - rename this folder
 - rename files in this folder (to rename flows, use the settings tab)
 
 **For further information, please refer to [the complete readme](https://github.com/tine-schreibt/textFlow/blob/main/README.md)**
